mapper.update: UPDATE shop_orders SET logistics_delivered_at = COALESCE(logistics_delivered_at, #{deliveredAt}), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('SHIPPED', 'RECEIVED', 'COMPLETED')
mapper.select: SELECT i.product_id, p.merchant_id, p.name AS product_name, p.thumbnail_url, p.price AS unit_price, i.quantity FROM cart_items i JOIN carts c ON c.id = i.cart_id JOIN products p ON p.id = i.product_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY i.id FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO shop_orders( order_number, customer_id, status, total_amount, currency, payment_due_at, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{orderNumber}, #{customerId}, 'PENDING_PAYMENT', #{totalAmount}, #{currency}, #{paymentDueAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )

INSERT INTO order_events( order_id, actor_id, event_type, from_status, to_status, detail, trigger_source, scheduled_task_id, created_at ) VALUES ( #{orderId}, #{actorId}, #{type}, #{fromStatus}, #{toStatus}, #{detail}, #{triggerSource}, #{scheduledTaskId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM shop_orders WHERE customer_id = #{customerId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC
SELECT * FROM shop_orders WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM order_items WHERE order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY id
SELECT id, actor_id, event_type, from_status, to_status, detail, trigger_source, scheduled_task_id, created_at FROM order_events WHERE order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY created_at, id
SELECT * FROM payment_merchant_accounts WHERE channel = #{channel} AND enabled = TRUE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payment_idempotency_locks(idempotency_key, created_at) VALUES (#{key}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE idempotency_key = idempotency_key
mapper.select: SELECT idempotency_key FROM payment_idempotency_locks WHERE idempotency_key = #{key} FOR UPDATE
SELECT p.*, m.merchant_no FROM payment_records p LEFT JOIN payment_merchant_accounts m ON m.id = p.merchant_account_id WHERE p.idempotency_key = #{key}
SELECT p.*, m.merchant_no FROM payment_records p LEFT JOIN payment_merchant_accounts m ON m.id = p.merchant_account_id WHERE p.order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY p.id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM payment_records WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND status = 'SUCCESS'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payment_records( order_id, merchant_account_id, payment_number, idempotency_key, channel, currency, request_fingerprint, channel_transaction_no, amount, status, failure_reason, paid_at, expires_at, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{orderId}, #{merchantId}, #{number}, #{key}, #{channel}, #{currency}, #{fingerprint}, #{transactionNo}, #{amount}, #{status}, #{reason}, #{paidAt}, #{expiresAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: SELECT p.*, m.merchant_no FROM payment_records p LEFT JOIN payment_merchant_accounts m ON m.id = p.merchant_account_id WHERE p.channel_transaction_no = #{transactionNo} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payment_notifications( payment_id, channel, notification_id, channel_transaction_no, signature_valid, processing_status, payload_digest, failure_reason, raw_status, received_at, processed_at ) VALUES ( #{paymentId}, #{channel}, #{notificationId}, #{transactionNo}, TRUE, #{processingStatus}, #{digest}, #{reason}, #{rawStatus}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: UPDATE payment_records SET status = #{toStatus}, failure_reason = #{reason}, paid_at = CASE WHEN #{toStatus} = 'SUCCESS' THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE paid_at END, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING'
UPDATE payment_records SET status = 'CLOSED', failure_reason = #{reason}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING'
UPDATE shop_orders SET status = 'CANCELLING', cancel_reason = #{reason}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING_PAYMENT'
UPDATE shop_orders SET status = 'CANCELLED', cancelled_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'CANCELLING'
UPDATE shop_orders SET status = 'PAID', cancel_reason = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'CANCELLING'
UPDATE shop_orders SET status = 'PAID', cancelled_at = NULL, cancel_reason = 'Recovered after late successful payment', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'CANCELLED'
UPDATE shop_orders SET status = 'RECEIVED', received_at = #{receivedAt}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'SHIPPED'
UPDATE shop_orders SET status = 'COMPLETED', completed_at = #{completedAt}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'RECEIVED'
